title: PlacementParameterHead
description: A space's declared placement parameter head (item S4, E14): one declaration per space, naming one parameter set per kind, with the reach it is published at, the declaration it follows, and what ratified it. The head is declared, never 'latest': floors elect among the declarations they hold only after verifying each, newest notarized ratification first (`select_in_force`, E3, E4), and an unverifiable newer declaration never shadows an older verified one. A revert is a new declaration naming an earlier set's CID; the head never moves backward (concern C2). Scope and predecessor live here, not in the set (E1, E5). Incumbency is scoped to the set in force, and the built-in default set is exempt from ratification (operator ruling 2026-10-20). Wire shape: this schema is the source of record; placement_core::HeadDeclaration and RatificationRef (elohim/placement/core/src/params.rs; serde camelCase, deny_unknown_fields on the head) are its Rust mirror, not yet pinned to it by a test (follow-on: a placement-core schema_contract case that validates a serialized HeadDeclaration here). Source of truth: the space's head declaration. Category A2: the design gate's (declarer, space, `placement-parameters`) head identity, a household-local record below public reach (R2) and an EPR head declaration at collective or commons reach; no new DHT entry type.

scope.description: The space this head governs (VF in_scope_of), a CID string.

sets.description: Per kind, the set this head puts in force. A kind not named keeps the built-in set.

reach.description: Published at: who may see this head. It is in force for the space's members.

oneOf.description: The head declaration this one follows, a CID string.

predecessor.description: Null for a space's first declaration (one provenance).

ratifiedAt.description: The ratification's notarized timestamp, seconds since the Unix epoch: the election clock (spec C2, E4). Never a local clock. A u64 in Rust, bounded here to 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1, the largest integer every JSON reader, JavaScript included, holds exactly); a larger value is refused, never rounded.

RatificationRef.title: RatificationRef
RatificationRef.description: What put a set in force. A struct with a `by` field rather than an internally tagged enum, so its JSON and DAG-CBOR forms are both honest (G1). `built-in` and `charter` are verified by the floor itself; only `ratified` is handed to the adapter's RatificationCheck, which every floor re-derives (E9, concern C5).

id.description: For `ratified`, the ratifying act's record hash; for `charter`, the charter's CID. For `built-in`, the value the floor's InForce::builtin writes; interfaces spec §E leaves it unnamed (recorded as an open point in the lane-S report).

oneOf.description: The charter clause the tuning was ratified under (RatificationRule::Clause), a CID string.

rule.description: Null unless the tuning was ratified under a named clause (one provenance).

items.description: An agent key (`uhCAk…`), the canonical agent identity (elohim_epr_rea::model::AgentRef / AgentRefKey, a string newtype). Never a transport id and never a CID.

touches.description: Whose consent the household default (TouchedConsent) requires: the members the tuning touches (E8).
